item.title: Data Center LV Busbar Trunking: Complete Selection and Design Guide
item.description: Modern data centers are among the most power-dense facilities ever built. A single high-density rack can draw 30kW to 100kW — the equivalent of powering 30 to 100 residential homes from a footprint smaller than a parking space. As AI training clusters, GPU farms, and edge computing deployments push power densities ever higher, the electrical distribution infrastructure beneath the floor has become as critical as the IT equipment it supports.
